page: Microsoft Azure ND128isr_GB300_v6 is a specialized, hardware-isolated GPU accelerated instance designed for extreme-scale artificial intelligence and high-performance computing workloads. The system is powered by 128 dedicated arm64 vCPUs alongside 864.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 6.75 GB of RAM per vCPU core. Virtualization is delivered through Microsoft Hyper-V, ensuring strictly isolated execution for sensitive multi-tenant or regulatory-bound environments.

The primary computing capability centers on four integrated NVIDIA Blackwell GB300 GPUs, supplying a collective 1152 GB of high-bandwidth GPU memory. For large-scale distributed setups, the instance incorporates remote direct memory access (RDMA) networking capabilities, facilitating low-latency GPU-to-GPU node interconnectivity across multinode clusters.

Local I/O performance is supported by an onboard NVMe SSD configuration providing 16,460 GB of bundled local storage. This large local storage volume minimizes I/O bottlenecks when caching massive datasets or writing training checkpoints locally, while the platform simultaneously supports Azure Premium Storage.

From an operational perspective, ND128isr_GB300_v6 delivers extreme density for massive deep learning model training, frontier LLM fine-tuning, complex physics simulations, and ultra-large batch inference. Without complimentary public IPv4 addresses, it is intended to operate within protected private cloud networks and high-throughput cluster fabrics.
